newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Sept 6.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Over half a million people are taking shelter today as Hurricane Fran, the worst hurricane for seven years, hit Cape Fear.
MORGAN PROBE TURNS TO ROLE OF BROKERS

The Securites and Futures Authority is investigating the activities of two stockbrokers, Ice Securities and Fiba Nordic Securities, which had dealings with the suspended Morgan Grenfell investment funds.
SHARES AND BONDS SET TO TAKE US JOBS STRAIN
The expected bumper employment growth in the US, is likely to send the FT-SE 100 index lower, unless a rumoured multi-billion pound takeover comes out in the open today.

The Sumitomo copper scandal has led to moves by Britain's Securities and Investments Board, the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission, and Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry to reach a new co-operation agreement.
SCOTTISH PLANS PROTEST TO OFT OVER BASS DEAL

Scottish & Newcastle is to complain vigorously to the Office of Fair Trading, that Bass's 205 million stg acquisition of Carlsberg-Tetley from Allied Domecq gives Bass an unfair advantage in the brewing industry.
INFLATION BLIP LOOMS AS OIL PRICE SPIRALS
There will be in a blip in this autumn's inflation figures, if the surge in the oil price which followed the US attack on Saddam Hussein is sustained.
